decisions.reason: The source also affects the smaller V, but the existing message-114 MODIFY already captures its inheritance of the Option 2 Hero V termination and all stated adjustment constraints.

The existing message-114 MODIFY already records Option 2 as the near-final Hero V foundation and preserves its length, weight, curvature, and arm relationship; the shared terminal details are separately owned by the terminal-treatment Requirement.
Deriving the É accent from the Hero V termination does not change the deferred wordmark's composition, kerning, or visual-hierarchy rules.
The geometric derivation of the É accent does not alter the champagne-metal material treatment, sequencing, or material-role requirements.
The source applies the established quiet-confidence and becoming concepts to the terminal gesture but does not change the broader brand-expression state.
The source changes the V-system terminal relationship, not the deferred construction or visual language of the remaining proprietary letterforms.

The existing message-114 MODIFY already captures the decisive terminal conclusion, prohibited geometric changes, shared application to the Hero V, second V, and É accent, expanded scope, and intended expression.
The terminal-derived accent does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
